results.title: Q3 2026 Product Recap | Scaleway
results.author: Made with ❤️ by FWEB, VDESIGN, VI
highlights:
- ### Open: no lock-in, no limits

We believe the cloud should unlock innovation, not restrict it. Our Generative APIs are pushing the frontier of open AI with the addition of Qwen 3.8 27B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. To make building AI applications even more cost-effective, we’ve introduced Cached Token Pricing for both models. Finally, your data streaming and messaging backbones just got stronger: RabbitMQ has reached General Availability, and our fully managed Clusters for Apache Kafka® now support robust Multi-AZ architectures for ultimate reliability.

List of new products and features below.

| Product | Feature | Phase | Availability | Learn more |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Generative APIs | Qwen 3.8-27B & DeepSeek-V4-Flash | General Availability | August 2026 | Documentation |
| Generative APIs | Cached tokens pricing | General Availability | August 2026 | Documentation |
| Cloud Essentials for RabbitMQ | Cloud Essentials for RabbitMQ | General Availability | August 2026 | Documentation |
| Clusters for Apache Kafka® | Multi-AZ clusters | General Availability | September 2026 | Documentation |
| Instances | CPU Instances Template | General Availability | July 2026 | Documentation |
| Kubernetes Kapsule | Support for user-data | General Availability | August 2026 | Product page |
| Key Manager | Post-Quantum Cryptography support | General Availability | September 2026 | Product page |

results.title: Scaleway et Dataiku s’associent pour aider les entreprises à construire et déployer l’IA en Europe | Scaleway
results.author: Made with ❤️ by FWEB, VDESIGN, VI
highlights:
Paris, le 6 octobre 2026 - Scaleway et Dataiku annoncent un partenariat pour aider les entreprises à développer et déployer des projets d’IA dans un environnement cloud européen souverain. Ce partenariat permettra aux clients de Dataiku d’exécuter les fonctionnalités de la plateforme Dataiku sur l’infrastructure Scaleway. Ainsi, ils disposeront de la performance nécessaire à leurs projets d’IA, tout en bénéficiant d’un environnement cloud souverain, entièrement gouverné en Europe à l'abri des lois extraterritoriales non européennes. Scaleway pourra également proposer les solutions Dataiku à ses clients lorsque la plateforme correspond à leurs besoins spécifiques en matière d’IA.
